scripts.package: rm -rf ./dist && cp -r ../desktop/dist . && cp ../desktop/.env ./dist && cp src/AppIcon.png ./dist/ui/public && cp src/AppIcon.ico ./dist/ui/public && echo 'done'
scripts.dist: node scripts/prepare-variant.js prod && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false NODE_ENV=production VERSION=$(node ../common/scripts/show_tag.js) MODEL_VERSION=$(node ../common/scripts/show_version.js) electron-builder build -p never
scripts.dist-local: node scripts/prepare-variant.js prod && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false NODE_ENV=production VERSION=$(node ../common/scripts/show_tag.js) MODEL_VERSION=$(node ../common/scripts/show_version.js) electron-builder build -p never
scripts.dist-signed: node scripts/prepare-variant.js prod && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=true NODE_ENV=production VERSION=$(node ../common/scripts/show_tag.js) MODEL_VERSION=$(node ../common/scripts/show_version.js) electron-builder build -c.afterSign=scripts/notarize.js -p never
scripts.dist-staging: node scripts/prepare-variant.js staging && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false NODE_ENV=production VERSION=$(node ../common/scripts/show_tag.js) MODEL_VERSION=$(node ../common/scripts/show_version.js) electron-builder build -c scripts/staging.config.cjs -p never
scripts.dist-staging-signed: node scripts/prepare-variant.js staging && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=true TRACEX_NOTARIZE=true NODE_ENV=production VERSION=$(node ../common/scripts/show_tag.js) MODEL_VERSION=$(node ../common/scripts/show_version.js) electron-builder build -c scripts/staging.config.cjs -p never
scripts.dist-mac-win: node scripts/prepare-variant.js prod && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false NODE_ENV=production VERSION=$(node ../common/scripts/show_tag.js) MODEL_VERSION=$(node ../common/scripts/show_version.js) electron-builder build --windows --x64 -p never
